description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: an eval whose text fails to transpile writes no eval-cache entry, so a warm run re-transpiles it (and starts the server) every time.  Measured with a hook on pcl::p-transpile-string (scratch/s541a/dev/whoeval.lisp: prints each call = each cache MISS) on the warm board cache: Class-Method-Modifiers t/003-basic.t sends "return 1; &_sub = 1" (CMM's lvalue probe, line 214 of Class/Method/Modifiers.pm) FOUR times per run, every run; Pod-Simple basic.t sends BlackBox's two my_qr evals (they fail by #5061) every run; scratch/s541a/dev/evalprobe2.sh runs a probe three times on a fresh cache: the failing texts miss on runs 2 and 3, the good ones hit.

BOARD: the eval transpile share of the run (evalx wall) is 4.42 s over 30 files / 10 dists; CMM's files pay 0.13-0.18 s each, Pod-Simple's ~0.13 s each.

LEVER: cache a FAILED transpile like a successful one (the result is a function of the same key: text + package + capture names + features + the compiler stamp) -- a negative entry that replays the same perl-shaped compile error without the server.  Discriminating measurement for whoever takes it: CMM t/003-basic.t warm run, evalx wall (tools/board-timing.pl --run row) 0.14 s -> ~0, and the hook shows 0 requests on run 2.  Size: one session.  Related: #5061 (one of the failures is a bug), #5068 (the other is a PCL rejection perl does not make).
subject: PERF: a string eval whose TRANSPILE FAILS is never cached -- the same text is re-sent to the pl2cl server at every execution and the server (~0.13-0.15 s to start) is started in EVERY run: 4.42 s of eval-transpile misses over 30 board files / 10 dists (Class-Method-Modifiers 26 files, Pod-Simple via #5061)
